title: Kubuswoningen
blurb: Piet Blom’s 1984 cube houses: 38 tilted cubes on hexagonal pylons, each a tree in an urban forest above the Blaak.

systems.name: Hexagonal pylons
systems.description: Reinforced concrete hexagonal trunks the cubes balance on.

systems.name: Tilted cubes
systems.description: The 38 houses: cubes tilted so one vertex points down, each a tree in Blom’s forest.

systems.name: Pyramid roofs
systems.description: Pyramid top rooms crowning each cube.

systems.name: Windows
systems.description: Glazing set into the 54.7-degree sloped walls.

systems.name: Super-cubes
systems.description: The two larger cubes, converted to a hostel in 2009.

systems.name: Pedestrian bridge
systems.description: The deck and railings of the bridge the complex forms over the road.

systems.name: Ground level
systems.description: Shops at street level beneath the forest of houses.
